title: Clarify AoU traceability and visibility
body:
### What

Config Management needs to use the communication Assumptions of Use from [aou.trlc](https://github.com/eclipse-score/communication/blob/edaa61e1ca2e7929b6655073ea0534d92b6b652f/score/mw/com/dependability/safety_analysis/aou.trlc#L18) in its component requirements.

This functionality is supported by the [SCORE tooling AoU forwarding change](https://github.com/eclipse-score/tooling/pull/377/files). However, the required communication AoU target is currently not publicly visible to Config Management, preventing its use across repository boundaries.

Please clarify the recommended implementation that enables Config Management to consume and forward these AoUs while maintaining correct FMEA and LOBSTER traceability without duplicate processing.
